problem.statement: The repository contains overlapping platform, partner, tenant, operational, and financial descriptions that can route actors and financial access through contradictory ownership models.
problem.currentWorkaround: Individual capabilities infer platform semantics from service-local contracts and runtime configuration.

actors.role: Operates the BThwani platform and its governed cross-surface capabilities.
permittedActions: read operational and authorized financial projections
forbiddenActions: mutate WLT financial truth through DSH
treat a partner or store as an operator context

actors.role: Operates partner organizations and stores under an authorized platform context.
forbiddenActions: select or override platform isolation context

actors.role: Performs BThwani-affiliated or partner-affiliated delivery work.
forbiddenActions: change affiliation through a request context

actors.role: Performs authorized field onboarding, verification, and readiness work.
permittedActions: create and review authorized field evidence

actors.role: Discovers stores, creates commerce intents, receives fulfillment, and views owned financial references.
permittedActions: request owned payment or refund workflows through DSH

actions: consume DSH commerce, fulfillment, and financial facade
operate authorized partner resources through DSH
operate assigned fulfillment and consume DSH financial projections
govern and operate through owner facades
persist owner truth within service boundaries
reuse generated owner contracts and shared transports

outcome.statement: Every surface uses one actor model, one trusted operator-context model, one operational owner, and one financial-truth owner.
outcome.baselineState: Overlapping tenant vocabulary, direct WLT consumers, hand-authored generated clients, and context-local composition.
outcome.targetState: Zero in-scope semantic, trust, financial-access, provenance, and contract-composition violations.
outcome.observationWindow: Every affected request, generated-contract check, targeted runtime smoke, and same-commit CI run.

criteria: Partner organizations and stores are never treated as operator contexts.
Current partner capabilities are managed B2B platform access, not SaaS tenancy.
All application financial access is routed through DSH and all financial truth remains in WLT.
Exactly six bounded-context clients are deterministically generated from composed bundles.
Client-supplied context cannot authorize or override trusted context.
SaaS remains deferred and no production or commercial activation is implied.
failureStates: A client controls trusted operator context.
DSH calculates or mutates authoritative financial truth.
A generated client is hand-authored or stale.
A partner or store is represented as a tenant.
A current partner capability is classified as SaaS tenancy.

business: BThwani is a unified multi-surface B2B2C commerce, fulfillment, and wallet platform with managed B2B partner capabilities and deferred operator SaaS readiness.
DSH owns operational truth and the application-facing financial facade.
WLT solely owns financial truth and financial mutation.
Captain affiliation is explicitly BTHWANI or PARTNER.
Operator context is derived from trusted identity or server-side delegation.
negative: Partner Organization is not a tenant.
Current partner access is not a SaaS tenant boundary.
Applications do not call WLT directly.
DSH does not own ledger, wallet, payment, refund, settlement, payout, commission, or reconciliation truth.
SaaS readiness does not imply commercial or production activation.

execution.appetite: Complete the approved repository reconstruction on validclean without merge, deployment, or protected-domain closure.
fixedConstraints: validclean and its resolved immutable SHA are the only repository truth
WLT is the sole financial-truth owner
DSH is the sole application-facing financial facade
same-commit automated checks cannot be waived
forbiddenScope: self-approved security, isolation, finance, release, production, or final closure
fake, seed, fixture, or preview truth presented as runtime evidence
execution.forecastRange: One bounded reconstruction sequence followed by targeted and contextual verification.
